action_summary: Repairs the shipped generalisation organ, which on main did not parse: a merge commit carried two conflict regions into edit_by_example_v1.py, so 10 test files could not be collected and the function every claim calls was unreachable. Then measures the owner's claim - give it the action once and it is learned in a new environment - instead of arguing it: one showing is refused on all four new shapes tried, including the same defect under different variable names; two showings from two places do reach a name never shown, and still offer to change a boundary that is required. Also measures the 'Problem 2 completely solved' document on main: 24 records holding 8 distinct tasks, none of them a failure, and an executed answer that does not come from the memory. Adds no capability, flips no family, claims no benchmark movement.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: DELETE does not apply (the organ is load-bearing and is kept, repaired), BYPASS does not apply (there is no other route to the lesson), and REUSE is what this does: the repo's own organ, its own ladder, and its own test runner, with no new capability.
